/home/dude/FrostyFunds/funds-core/src/libraries/LiquidityAmounts.sol
  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
  2 |     | pragma solidity 0.8.24;
  3 |     | 
  4 |     | import {Math} from '@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol';
  5 |     | 
  6 |     | /// @title LiquidityAmounts
  7 |     | /// @notice Read-side subset of Uniswap's periphery LiquidityAmounts: splits `liquidity` over
  8 |     | ///         a tick range into its underlying token amounts at a given sqrt price.
  9 |     | /// @dev Canonical formulas, on OZ Math.mulDiv (512-bit intermediates). Rounds down — the
 10 |     | ///      conservative direction for valuation.
 11 |     | library LiquidityAmounts {
 12 |     | 	uint256 private constant Q96 = 0x1000000000000000000000000;
 13 |     | 
 14 |     | 	/// @notice amount0 for `liquidity` between sqrtRatioA and sqrtRatioB (A < B).
 15 |     | 	function getAmount0ForLiquidity(uint160 sqrtRatioAX96, uint160 sqrtRatioBX96, uint128 liquidity)
 16 |     | 		internal
 17 |     | 		pure
 18 |     | 		returns (uint256 amount0)
 19 |     | 	{
 20 |     | 		if (sqrtRatioAX96 > sqrtRatioBX96) (sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96) = (sqrtRatioBX96, sqrtRatioAX96);
 21 |     | 		return
 22 |     | 			Math.mulDiv(uint256(liquidity) << 96, sqrtRatioBX96 - sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96) / sqrtRatioAX96;
 23 |     | 	}
 24 |     | 
 25 |     | 	/// @notice amount1 for `liquidity` between sqrtRatioA and sqrtRatioB (A < B).
 26 |     | 	function getAmount1ForLiquidity(uint160 sqrtRatioAX96, uint160 sqrtRatioBX96, uint128 liquidity)
 27 |     | 		internal
 28 |     | 		pure
 29 |     | 		returns (uint256 amount1)
 30 |     | 	{
 31 |     | 		if (sqrtRatioAX96 > sqrtRatioBX96) (sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96) = (sqrtRatioBX96, sqrtRatioAX96);
 32 |     | 		return Math.mulDiv(liquidity, sqrtRatioBX96 - sqrtRatioAX96, Q96);
 33 |     | 	}
 34 |     | 
 35 |     | 	/// @notice Token amounts for `liquidity` over [sqrtRatioA, sqrtRatioB] at `sqrtRatioX96`.
 36 |     | 	function getAmountsForLiquidity(
 37 |     | 		uint160 sqrtRatioX96,
 38 |     | 		uint160 sqrtRatioAX96,
 39 |     | 		uint160 sqrtRatioBX96,
 40 |     | 		uint128 liquidity
 41 |     | 	) internal pure returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
 42 |     | 		if (sqrtRatioAX96 > sqrtRatioBX96) (sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96) = (sqrtRatioBX96, sqrtRatioAX96);
 43 |     | 
 44 |     | 		if (sqrtRatioX96 <= sqrtRatioAX96) {
 45 |     | 			amount0 = getAmount0ForLiquidity(sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96, liquidity);
 46 |     | 		} else if (sqrtRatioX96 < sqrtRatioBX96) {
 47 |     | 			amount0 = getAmount0ForLiquidity(sqrtRatioX96, sqrtRatioBX96, liquidity);
 48 |     | 			amount1 = getAmount1ForLiquidity(sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioX96, liquidity);
 49 |     | 		} else {
 50 |     | 			amount1 = getAmount1ForLiquidity(sqrtRatioAX96, sqrtRatioBX96, liquidity);
 51 |     | 		}
 52 |     | 	}
 53 |     | }
 54 |     | 

/home/dude/FrostyFunds/funds-core/src/libraries/MathHelpers.sol
  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0
  2 |     | pragma solidity 0.8.24;
  3 |     | 
  4 |     | import {Math} from '@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol';
  5 |     | 
  6 |     | /// @title MathHelpers
  7 |     | library MathHelpers {
  8 |     | 	/// @notice Fixed-point exponentiation by squaring: (x/base)^n scaled by base.
  9 |     | 	/// @dev Used for the management fee's continuous compounding
 10 |     | 	///      (spec/fee-formulas/managementfee.md: sharesDue = (rpow(rate, dt, 1e27) - 1e27) * TS / 1e27).
 11 |     | 	///      Rounds down at each step — the bias slightly under-charges the fee, never over.
 12 | *   | 	function rpow(uint256 x, uint256 n, uint256 base) internal pure returns (uint256 z) {
 13 | *   | 		z = base;
 14 | *   | 		while (n > 0) {
 15 | *   | 			if (n & 1 == 1) {
 16 | *   | 				z = Math.mulDiv(z, x, base);
 17 |     | 			}
 18 | *   | 			x = Math.mulDiv(x, x, base);
 19 | *   | 			n >>= 1;
 20 |     | 		}
 21 |     | 	}
 22 |     | }
 23 |     | 

/home/dude/FrostyFunds/funds-core/src/libraries/TickMath.sol
   1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
   2 |     | pragma solidity >=0.5.0;
   3 |     | 
   4 |     | /// @title Math library for computing sqrt prices from ticks and vice versa
   5 |     | /// @notice Computes sqrt price for ticks of size 1.0001, i.e. sqrt(1.0001^tick) as fixed point Q64.96 numbers. Supports
   6 |     | /// prices between 2**-128 and 2**128
   7 |     | library TickMath {
   8 |     |     /// @dev The minimum tick that may be passed to #getSqrtRatioAtTick computed from log base 1.0001 of 2**-128
   9 |     |     int24 internal constant MIN_TICK = -887272;
  10 |     |     /// @dev The maximum tick that may be passed to #getSqrtRatioAtTick computed from log base 1.0001 of 2**128
  11 |     |     int24 internal constant MAX_TICK = -MIN_TICK;
  12 |     | 
  13 |     |     /// @dev The minimum value that can be returned from #getSqrtRatioAtTick. Equivalent to getSqrtRatioAtTick(MIN_TICK)
  14 |     |     uint160 internal constant MIN_SQRT_RATIO = 4295128739;
  15 |     |     /// @dev The maximum value that can be returned from #getSqrtRatioAtTick. Equivalent to getSqrtRatioAtTick(MAX_TICK)
  16 |     |     uint160 internal constant MAX_SQRT_RATIO = 1461446703485210103287273052203988822378723970342;
  17 |     | 
  18 |     |     /// @notice Calculates sqrt(1.0001^tick) * 2^96
  19 |     |     /// @dev Throws if |tick| > max tick
  20 |     |     /// @param tick The input tick for the above formula
  21 |     |     /// @return sqrtPriceX96 A Fixed point Q64.96 number representing the sqrt of the ratio of the two assets (token1/token0)
  22 |     |     /// at the given tick
  23 |     |     function getSqrtRatioAtTick(int24 tick) internal pure returns (uint160 sqrtPriceX96) {
  24 |     |         uint256 absTick = tick < 0 ? uint256(-int256(tick)) : uint256(int256(tick));
  25 |     |         require(absTick <= uint256(uint24(MAX_TICK)), 'T');
  26 |     | 
  27 |     |         uint256 ratio = absTick & 0x1 != 0 ? 0xfffcb933bd6fad37aa2d162d1a594001 : 0x100000000000000000000000000000000;
  28 |     |         if (absTick & 0x2 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xfff97272373d413259a46990580e213a) >> 128;
  29 |     |         if (absTick & 0x4 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xfff2e50f5f656932ef12357cf3c7fdcc) >> 128;
  30 |     |         if (absTick & 0x8 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xffe5caca7e10e4e61c3624eaa0941cd0) >> 128;
  31 |     |         if (absTick & 0x10 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xffcb9843d60f6159c9db58835c926644) >> 128;
  32 |     |         if (absTick & 0x20 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xff973b41fa98c081472e6896dfb254c0) >> 128;
  33 |     |         if (absTick & 0x40 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xff2ea16466c96a3843ec78b326b52861) >> 128;
  34 |     |         if (absTick & 0x80 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xfe5dee046a99a2a811c461f1969c3053) >> 128;
  35 |     |         if (absTick & 0x100 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xfcbe86c7900a88aedcffc83b479aa3a4) >> 128;
  36 |     |         if (absTick & 0x200 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xf987a7253ac413176f2b074cf7815e54) >> 128;
  37 |     |         if (absTick & 0x400 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xf3392b0822b70005940c7a398e4b70f3) >> 128;
  38 |     |         if (absTick & 0x800 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xe7159475a2c29b7443b29c7fa6e889d9) >> 128;
  39 |     |         if (absTick & 0x1000 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xd097f3bdfd2022b8845ad8f792aa5825) >> 128;
  40 |     |         if (absTick & 0x2000 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0xa9f746462d870fdf8a65dc1f90e061e5) >> 128;
  41 |     |         if (absTick & 0x4000 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0x70d869a156d2a1b890bb3df62baf32f7) >> 128;
  42 |     |         if (absTick & 0x8000 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0x31be135f97d08fd981231505542fcfa6) >> 128;
  43 |     |         if (absTick & 0x10000 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0x9aa508b5b7a84e1c677de54f3e99bc9) >> 128;
  44 |     |         if (absTick & 0x20000 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0x5d6af8dedb81196699c329225ee604) >> 128;
  45 |     |         if (absTick & 0x40000 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0x2216e584f5fa1ea926041bedfe98) >> 128;
  46 |     |         if (absTick & 0x80000 != 0) ratio = (ratio * 0x48a170391f7dc42444e8fa2) >> 128;
  47 |     | 
  48 |     |         if (tick > 0) ratio = type(uint256).max / ratio;
  49 |     | 
  50 |     |         // this divides by 1<<32 rounding up to go from a Q128.128 to a Q128.96.
  51 |     |         // we then downcast because we know the result always fits within 160 bits due to our tick input constraint
  52 |     |         // we round up in the division so getTickAtSqrtRatio of the output price is always consistent
  53 |     |         sqrtPriceX96 = uint160((ratio >> 32) + (ratio % (1 << 32) == 0 ? 0 : 1));
  54 |     |     }
  55 |     | 
  56 |     |     /// @notice Calculates the greatest tick value such that getRatioAtTick(tick) <= ratio
  57 |     |     /// @dev Throws in case sqrtPriceX96 < MIN_SQRT_RATIO, as MIN_SQRT_RATIO is the lowest value getRatioAtTick may
  58 |     |     /// ever return.
  59 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceX96 The sqrt ratio for which to compute the tick as a Q64.96
  60 |     |     /// @return tick The greatest tick for which the ratio is less than or equal to the input ratio
  61 |     |     function getTickAtSqrtRatio(uint160 sqrtPriceX96) internal pure returns (int24 tick) {
  62 |     |         // second inequality must be < because the price can never reach the price at the max tick
  63 |     |         require(sqrtPriceX96 >= MIN_SQRT_RATIO && sqrtPriceX96 < MAX_SQRT_RATIO, 'R');
  64 |     |         uint256 ratio = uint256(sqrtPriceX96) << 32;
  65 |     | 
  66 |     |         uint256 r = ratio;
  67 |     |         uint256 msb = 0;
  68 |     | 
  69 |     |         assembly {
  70 |     |             let f := shl(7, gt(r, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF))
  71 |     |             msb := or(msb, f)
  72 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
  73 |     |         }
  74 |     |         assembly {
  75 |     |             let f := shl(6, gt(r, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF))
  76 |     |             msb := or(msb, f)
  77 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
  78 |     |         }
  79 |     |         assembly {
  80 |     |             let f := shl(5, gt(r, 0xFFFFFFFF))
  81 |     |             msb := or(msb, f)
  82 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
  83 |     |         }
  84 |     |         assembly {
  85 |     |             let f := shl(4, gt(r, 0xFFFF))
  86 |     |             msb := or(msb, f)
  87 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
  88 |     |         }
  89 |     |         assembly {
  90 |     |             let f := shl(3, gt(r, 0xFF))
  91 |     |             msb := or(msb, f)
  92 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
  93 |     |         }
  94 |     |         assembly {
  95 |     |             let f := shl(2, gt(r, 0xF))
  96 |     |             msb := or(msb, f)
  97 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
  98 |     |         }
  99 |     |         assembly {
 100 |     |             let f := shl(1, gt(r, 0x3))
 101 |     |             msb := or(msb, f)
 102 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
 103 |     |         }
 104 |     |         assembly {
 105 |     |             let f := gt(r, 0x1)
 106 |     |             msb := or(msb, f)
 107 |     |         }
 108 |     | 
 109 |     |         if (msb >= 128) r = ratio >> (msb - 127);
 110 |     |         else r = ratio << (127 - msb);
 111 |     | 
 112 |     |         int256 log_2 = (int256(msb) - 128) << 64;
 113 |     | 
 114 |     |         assembly {
 115 |     |             r := shr(127, mul(r, r))
 116 |     |             let f := shr(128, r)
 117 |     |             log_2 := or(log_2, shl(63, f))
 118 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
 119 |     |         }
 120 |     |         assembly {
 121 |     |             r := shr(127, mul(r, r))
 122 |     |             let f := shr(128, r)
 123 |     |             log_2 := or(log_2, shl(62, f))
 124 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
 125 |     |         }
 126 |     |         assembly {
 127 |     |             r := shr(127, mul(r, r))
 128 |     |             let f := shr(128, r)
 129 |     |             log_2 := or(log_2, shl(61, f))
 130 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
 131 |     |         }
 132 |     |         assembly {
 133 |     |             r := shr(127, mul(r, r))
 134 |     |             let f := shr(128, r)
 135 |     |             log_2 := or(log_2, shl(60, f))
 136 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
 137 |     |         }
 138 |     |         assembly {
 139 |     |             r := shr(127, mul(r, r))
 140 |     |             let f := shr(128, r)
 141 |     |             log_2 := or(log_2, shl(59, f))
 142 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
 143 |     |         }
 144 |     |         assembly {
 145 |     |             r := shr(127, mul(r, r))
 146 |     |             let f := shr(128, r)
 147 |     |             log_2 := or(log_2, shl(58, f))
 148 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
 149 |     |         }
 150 |     |         assembly {
 151 |     |             r := shr(127, mul(r, r))
 152 |     |             let f := shr(128, r)
 153 |     |             log_2 := or(log_2, shl(57, f))
 154 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
 155 |     |         }
 156 |     |         assembly {
 157 |     |             r := shr(127, mul(r, r))
 158 |     |             let f := shr(128, r)
 159 |     |             log_2 := or(log_2, shl(56, f))
 160 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
 161 |     |         }
 162 |     |         assembly {
 163 |     |             r := shr(127, mul(r, r))
 164 |     |             let f := shr(128, r)
 165 |     |             log_2 := or(log_2, shl(55, f))
 166 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
 167 |     |         }
 168 |     |         assembly {
 169 |     |             r := shr(127, mul(r, r))
 170 |     |             let f := shr(128, r)
 171 |     |             log_2 := or(log_2, shl(54, f))
 172 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
 173 |     |         }
 174 |     |         assembly {
 175 |     |             r := shr(127, mul(r, r))
 176 |     |             let f := shr(128, r)
 177 |     |             log_2 := or(log_2, shl(53, f))
 178 |     |             r := shr(f, r)
 179 |     |         }
 180 |     |         assembly {
 181 |     |             r := shr(127, mul(r, r))
 182 |     |             let f := shr(128, r)

 199 |     |

  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0
  2 |     | pragma solidity 0.8.24;
  3 |     | 
  4 |     | import {IPolicy} from '../interfaces/IPolicy.sol';
  5 |     | 
  6 |     | /// @title AllowedAdapterIncomingAssetsPolicy
  7 |     | /// @notice Whitelist of assets a fund may ACQUIRE through adapter trades — the fund's
  8 |     | ///         investable-universe commitment to depositors.
  9 |     | /// @dev Port of melon-v1 AssetWhitelist (melon-v1/src/fund/policies/risk-management/
 10 |     | ///      AssetWhitelist.sol) as v4's AllowedAdapterIncomingAssetsPolicy
 11 |     | ///      (spec/topics/policies.md). Immutable set — deploy a new instance to change it.
 12 |     | contract AllowedAdapterIncomingAssetsPolicy is IPolicy {
 13 |     | 	mapping(address asset => bool) public isAllowedAsset;
 14 |     | 
 15 |     | 	error IncomingAssetNotAllowed(address asset);
 16 |     | 
 17 |     | 	constructor(address[] memory allowedAssets) {
 18 |     | 		for (uint256 i; i < allowedAssets.length; ++i) {
 19 |     | 			isAllowedAsset[allowedAssets[i]] = true;
 20 |     | 		}
 21 |     | 	}
 22 |     | 
 23 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IPolicy
 24 |     | 	function validate(PolicyHook, bytes calldata validationData) external view {
 25 |     | 		(,,, address[] memory incomingAssets,) =
 26 |     | 			abi.decode(validationData, (address, address[], uint256[], address[], uint256[]));
 27 |     | 		for (uint256 i; i < incomingAssets.length; ++i) {
 28 |     | 			if (!isAllowedAsset[incomingAssets[i]]) revert IncomingAssetNotAllowed(incomingAssets[i]);
 29 |     | 		}
 30 |     | 	}
 31 |     | 
 32 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IPolicy
 33 |     | 	function implementedHooks() external pure returns (PolicyHook[] memory hooks) {
 34 |     | 		hooks = new PolicyHook[](1);
 35 |     | 		hooks[0] = PolicyHook.PostCallOnIntegration;
 36 |     | 	}
 37 |     | }
 38 |     |

  3 |     | 
  4 |     | import {Ownable} from '@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol';
  5 |     | import {Ownable2Step} from '@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable2Step.sol';
  6 |     | import {EnumerableSet} from '@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/structs/EnumerableSet.sol';
  7 |     | import {IPolicy} from '../interfaces/IPolicy.sol';
  8 |     | 
  9 |     | /// @title AllowedDepositorsPolicy
 10 |     | /// @notice Restricts deposits to a whitelist. The "regulated fund" building block.
 11 |     | /// @dev Successor to melon-v1 UserWhitelist (melon-v1/src/fund/policies/compliance/UserWhitelist.sol),
 12 |     | ///      as v4's AllowedDepositRecipientsPolicy (spec/topics/policies.md). One instance per fund,
 13 |     | ///      owned by the fund manager. Validates on PostDepositRequest (fail fast, before escrow
 14 |     | ///      sits for a day) and PostBuyShares (authoritative, at execution).
 15 |     | contract AllowedDepositorsPolicy is IPolicy, Ownable2Step {
 16 |     | 	using EnumerableSet for EnumerableSet.AddressSet;
 17 |     | 
 18 |     | 	EnumerableSet.AddressSet private depositors;
 19 |     | 
 20 |     | 	event DepositorAdded(address indexed depositor);
 21 |     | 	event DepositorRemoved(address indexed depositor);
 22 |     | 
 23 |     | 	error DepositorNotAllowed(address depositor);
 24 |     | 
 25 |     | 	constructor(address fundManager, address[] memory initialDepositors) Ownable(fundManager) {
 26 |     | 		for (uint256 i; i < initialDepositors.length; ++i) {
 27 |     | 			if (depositors.add(initialDepositors[i])) emit DepositorAdded(initialDepositors[i]);
 28 |     | 		}
 29 |     | 	}
 30 |     | 
 31 |     | 	function addDepositors(address[] calldata accounts) external onlyOwner {
 32 |     | 		for (uint256 i; i < accounts.length; ++i) {
 33 |     | 			if (depositors.add(accounts[i])) emit DepositorAdded(accounts[i]);
 34 |     | 		}
 35 |     | 	}
 36 |     | 
 37 |     | 	function removeDepositors(address[] calldata accounts) external onlyOwner {
 38 |     | 		for (uint256 i; i < accounts.length; ++i) {
 39 |     | 			if (depositors.remove(accounts[i])) emit DepositorRemoved(accounts[i]);
 40 |     | 		}
 41 |     | 	}
 42 |     | 
 43 |     | 	function isAllowed(address depositor) public view returns (bool) {
 44 |     | 		return depositors.contains(depositor);
 45 |     | 	}
 46 |     | 
 47 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IPolicy
 48 |     | 	function validate(PolicyHook, bytes calldata validationData) external view {
 49 |     | 		// PostDepositRequest: (depositor, assets). PostBuyShares: (depositor, assets, shares).
 50 |     | 		// The depositor is the first word in both encodings.
 51 |     | 		address depositor = abi.decode(validationData[:32], (address));
 52 |     | 		if (!isAllowed(depositor)) revert DepositorNotAllowed(depositor);
 53 |     | 	}
 54 |     | 
 55 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IPolicy
 56 |     | 	function implementedHooks() external pure returns (PolicyHook[] memory hooks) {
 57 |     | 		hooks = new PolicyHook[](2);
 58 |     | 		hooks[0] = PolicyHook.PostDepositRequest;
 59 |     | 		hooks[1] = PolicyHook.PostBuyShares;
 60 |     | 	}
 61 |     | }
 62 |     |

/home/dude/FrostyFunds/funds-core/src/policies/CumulativeSlippageTolerancePolicy.sol
  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0
  2 |     | pragma solidity 0.8.24;
  3 |     | 
  4 |     | import {Math} from '@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol';
  5 |     | import {IPolicy} from '../interfaces/IPolicy.sol';
  6 |     | import {Comptroller} from '../core/Comptroller.sol';
  7 |     | import {IValueInterpreter} from '../interfaces/IValueInterpreter.sol';
  8 |     | 
  9 |     | /// @title CumulativeSlippageTolerancePolicy
 10 |     | /// @notice Rate-limits value loss through adapter trades: each trade's slippage (spend value
 11 |     | ///         minus received value, as a fraction of fund GAV) accrues to a cumulative total
 12 |     | ///         that must stay under `toleranceBps`; the total replenishes linearly over 7 days.
 13 |     | /// @dev Port of Enzyme v4's CumulativeSlippageTolerancePolicy (spec/topics/policies.md):
 14 |     | ///      "slow the rate at which a malicious manager can drain a fund enough to allow
 15 |     | ///      alerting and exiting" — the core defense for anonymous marketplace managers.
 16 |     | ///      One instance is shareable by many funds (state is keyed by calling Comptroller).
 17 |     | contract CumulativeSlippageTolerancePolicy is IPolicy {
 18 |     | 	uint256 public constant BPS = 10_000;
 19 |     | 	uint256 public constant TOLERANCE_PERIOD = 7 days;
 20 |     | 
 21 |     | 	uint256 public immutable toleranceBps;
 22 |     | 
 23 |     | 	struct SlippageState {
 24 |     | 		uint128 cumulativeLossBps;
 25 |     | 		uint64 lastUpdated;
 26 |     | 	}
 27 |     | 
 28 |     | 	mapping(address comptroller => SlippageState) public slippageStates;
 29 |     | 
 30 |     | 	event SlippageAccrued(address indexed comptroller, uint256 lossBps, uint256 cumulativeLossBps);
 31 |     | 
 32 |     | 	error InvalidTolerance();
 33 |     | 	error CumulativeSlippageExceeded(uint256 cumulativeLossBps, uint256 toleranceBps);
 34 |     | 
 35 |     | 	constructor(uint256 toleranceBps_) {
 36 |     | 		if (toleranceBps_ == 0 || toleranceBps_ > BPS) revert InvalidTolerance();
 37 |     | 		toleranceBps = toleranceBps_;
 38 |     | 	}
 39 |     | 
 40 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IPolicy
 41 |     | 	function validate(PolicyHook, bytes calldata validationData) external {
 42 |     | 		(, address[] memory spendAssets, uint256[] memory spendAmounts, address[] memory incomingAssets, uint256[] memory incomingAmounts)
 43 |     | 		= abi.decode(validationData, (address, address[], uint256[], address[], uint256[]));
 44 |     | 
 45 |     | 		Comptroller comptroller = Comptroller(msg.sender);
 46 |     | 		IValueInterpreter interpreter = comptroller.valueInterpreter();
 47 |     | 		address denominationAsset = address(comptroller.denominationAsset());
 48 |     | 
 49 |     | 		uint256 spendValue;
 50 |     | 		for (uint256 i; i < spendAssets.length; ++i) {
 51 |     | 			spendValue += interpreter.calcCanonicalAssetValue(spendAssets[i], spendAmounts[i], denominationAsset);
 52 |     | 		}
 53 |     | 		uint256 incomingValue;
 54 |     | 		for (uint256 i; i < incomingAssets.length; ++i) {
 55 |     | 			incomingValue += interpreter.calcCanonicalAssetValue(incomingAssets[i], incomingAmounts[i], denominationAsset);
 56 |     | 		}
 57 |     | 
 58 |     | 		SlippageState memory state = slippageStates[msg.sender];
 59 |     | 
 60 |     | 		// Linear replenishment since the last accrual
 61 |     | 		if (state.cumulativeLossBps > 0 && state.lastUpdated > 0) {
 62 |     | 			uint256 replenished = (toleranceBps * (block.timestamp - state.lastUpdated)) / TOLERANCE_PERIOD;
 63 |     | 			state.cumulativeLossBps =
 64 |     | 				replenished >= state.cumulativeLossBps ? 0 : uint128(state.cumulativeLossBps - replenished);
 65 |     | 		}
 66 |     | 
 67 |     | 		if (spendValue > incomingValue) {
 68 |     | 			uint256 loss = spendValue - incomingValue;
 69 |     | 			// Loss relative to pre-trade fund value (post-trade GAV + the loss itself)
 70 |     | 			uint256 gav = comptroller.calcGav();
 71 |     | 			uint256 lossBps = Math.mulDiv(loss, BPS, gav + loss);
 72 |     | 
 73 |     | 			state.cumulativeLossBps += uint128(lossBps);
 74 |     | 			if (state.cumulativeLossBps > toleranceBps) {
 75 |     | 				revert CumulativeSlippageExceeded(state.cumulativeLossBps, toleranceBps);
 76 |     | 			}
 77 |     | 			emit SlippageAccrued(msg.sender, lossBps, state.cumulativeLossBps);
 78 |     | 		}
 79 |     | 
 80 |     | 		state.lastUpdated = uint64(block.timestamp);
 81 |     | 		slippageStates[msg.sender] = state;
 82 |     | 	}
 83 |     | 
 84 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IPolicy
 85 |     | 	function implementedHooks() external pure returns (PolicyHook[] memory hooks) {
 86 |     | 		hooks = new PolicyHook[](1);
 87 |     | 		hooks[0] = PolicyHook.PostCallOnIntegration;
 88 |     | 	}
 89 |     | }
 90 |     |

/home/dude/FrostyFunds/funds-core/src/policies/MaxConcentrationPolicy.sol
  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0
  2 |     | pragma solidity 0.8.24;
  3 |     | 
  4 |     | import {IERC20} from '@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol';
  5 |     | import {Math} from '@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol';
  6 |     | import {IPolicy} from '../interfaces/IPolicy.sol';
  7 |     | import {Comptroller} from '../core/Comptroller.sol';
  8 |     | 
  9 |     | /// @title MaxConcentrationPolicy
 10 |     | /// @notice After any adapter trade, no single non-denomination asset may exceed a fixed
 11 |     | ///         fraction of the fund's GAV.
 12 |     | /// @dev Port of melon-v1 MaxConcentration (melon-v1/src/fund/policies/risk-management/
 13 |     | ///      MaxConcentration.sol) on the PostCallOnIntegration hook. Immutable bound — deploy a
 14 |     | ///      new instance to change it. The calling fund is msg.sender (its Comptroller).
 15 |     | contract MaxConcentrationPolicy is IPolicy {
 16 |     | 	uint256 public constant BPS = 10_000;
 17 |     | 
 18 |     | 	uint256 public immutable maxConcentrationBps;
 19 |     | 
 20 |     | 	error MaxConcentrationExceeded(address asset, uint256 concentrationBps);
 21 |     | 	error InvalidConcentration();
 22 |     | 
 23 |     | 	constructor(uint256 maxConcentrationBps_) {
 24 |     | 		if (maxConcentrationBps_ == 0 || maxConcentrationBps_ > BPS) revert InvalidConcentration();
 25 |     | 		maxConcentrationBps = maxConcentrationBps_;
 26 |     | 	}
 27 |     | 
 28 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IPolicy
 29 |     | 	function validate(PolicyHook, bytes calldata validationData) external {
 30 |     | 		(,,, address[] memory incomingAssets,) =
 31 |     | 			abi.decode(validationData, (address, address[], uint256[], address[], uint256[]));
 32 |     | 
 33 |     | 		Comptroller comptroller = Comptroller(msg.sender);
 34 |     | 		address denominationAsset = address(comptroller.denominationAsset());
 35 |     | 		uint256 gav = comptroller.calcGav();
 36 |     | 		if (gav == 0) return;
 37 |     | 
 38 |     | 		address vault = address(comptroller.vault());
 39 |     | 		for (uint256 i; i < incomingAssets.length; ++i) {
 40 |     | 			address asset = incomingAssets[i];
 41 |     | 			if (asset == denominationAsset) continue;
 42 |     | 
 43 |     | 			uint256 assetValue = comptroller.valueInterpreter().calcCanonicalAssetValue(
 44 |     | 				asset, IERC20(asset).balanceOf(vault), denominationAsset
 45 |     | 			);
 46 |     | 			uint256 concentrationBps = Math.mulDiv(assetValue, BPS, gav);
 47 |     | 			if (concentrationBps > maxConcentrationBps) revert MaxConcentrationExceeded(asset, concentrationBps);
 48 |     | 		}
 49 |     | 	}
 50 |     | 
 51 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IPolicy
 52 |     | 	function implementedHooks() external pure returns (PolicyHook[] memory hooks) {
 53 |     | 		hooks = new PolicyHook[](1);
 54 |     | 		hooks[0] = PolicyHook.PostCallOnIntegration;
 55 |     | 	}
 56 |     | }
 57 |     |

/home/dude/FrostyFunds/funds-core/src/positions/HyperliquidPerpPosition.sol
   1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0
   2 |     | pragma solidity 0.8.24;
   3 |     | 
   4 |     | import {IERC20} from '@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol';
   5 |     | import {SafeERC20} from '@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol';
   6 |     | import {Ownable} from '@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol';
   7 |     | import {Ownable2Step} from '@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable2Step.sol';
   8 |     | import {IExternalPosition} from '../interfaces/IExternalPosition.sol';
   9 |     | import {IExternalPositionTypeFactory} from '../interfaces/IExternalPositionTypeFactory.sol';
  10 |     | import {Comptroller} from '../core/Comptroller.sol';
  11 |     | 
  12 |     | /// @title HyperliquidPerpPosition
  13 |     | /// @notice External position representing the fund's Hyperliquid perp account — the hedge leg
  14 |     | ///         of the delta-neutral strategy. The account's equity (margin + unrealized PnL, in
  15 |     | ///         USDC terms) lives off-EVM on HyperCore and cannot be read synchronously from Base,
  16 |     | ///         so it is ORACLE-ATTESTED: a designated attestor (the keeper) posts equity, and the
  17 |     | ///         attestation expires after MAX_ATTESTATION_AGE.
  18 |     | /// @dev Pattern: Veda BoringVault's Accountant (off-chain-oracle share pricing) applied to
  19 |     | ///      Enzyme v4's external-position shape. Consequences of expiry mirror the equity-feed
  20 |     | ///      heartbeat design: stale attestation → GAV reverts → deposits and value-redemptions
  21 |     | ///      halt; the in-kind exit never prices this position (its value is forfeited there, per
  22 |     | ///      spec/topics/fund-holdings.md — one more reason funds must prefer value redemption).
  23 |     | ///
  24 |     | ///      Fund flow: Comptroller.callOnExternalPosition moves USDC vault → this contract, then
  25 |     | ///      the DepositToHyperliquid action forwards it to the fund's immutable Hyperliquid
  26 |     | ///      deposit account (bridge). Withdrawals arrive from the bridge to THIS contract's
  27 |     | ///      address, and the ReturnToVault action moves them home. The attestor re-attests after
  28 |     | ///      every flow.
  29 |     | ///
  30 |     | ///      TRUST NOTE: the attestor prices this position (like Veda's Accountant). Production
  31 |     | ///      hardening before mainnet pooled deposits: multi-attestor median and/or per-interval
  32 |     | ///      equity-delta bounds. Tracked in the living doc.
  33 |     | contract HyperliquidPerpPosition is IExternalPosition {
  34 |     | 	using SafeERC20 for IERC20;
  35 |     | 
  36 |     | 	enum Action {
  37 |     | 		DepositToHyperliquid,
  38 |     | 		ReturnToVault
  39 |     | 	}
  40 |     | 
  41 |     | 	uint256 public constant MAX_ATTESTATION_AGE = 1 days;
  42 |     | 
  43 |     | 	address public immutable comptroller;
  44 |     | 	/// @notice The type factory that deployed this position — the single, protocol-wide
  45 |     | 	///         source of attestor truth. Managers can never choose or change who prices
  46 |     | 	///         the hedge (see AUDIT_TOOLING_RESULTS.md, attestor trust note).
  47 |     | 	HyperliquidPerpPositionFactory public immutable positionFactory;
  48 |     | 	IERC20 public immutable usdc;
  49 |     | 	/// @notice The fund's Hyperliquid deposit (bridge) account. Immutable: neither the
  50 |     | 	///         manager nor the attestor can redirect exchange-bound funds elsewhere.
  51 |     | 	address public immutable hyperliquidDepositAccount;
  52 |     | 
  53 |     | 	uint256 public attestedEquity; // USDC units (6 decimals)
  54 |     | 	uint256 public attestedAt;
  55 |     | 
  56 |     | 	event EquityAttested(uint256 equity, uint256 timestamp);
  57 |     | 	event DepositedToHyperliquid(uint256 amount);
  58 |     | 	event ReturnedToVault(uint256 amount);
  59 |     | 
  60 |     | 	error OnlyComptroller();
  61 |     | 	error OnlyAttestor();
  62 |     | 	error StaleAttestation(uint256 attestedAt);
  63 |     | 	error UnknownAction();
  64 |     | 	error ZeroAddress();
  65 |     | 
  66 |     | 	modifier onlyComptroller() {
  67 |     | 		if (msg.sender != comptroller) revert OnlyComptroller();
  68 |     | 		_;
  69 |     | 	}
  70 |     | 
  71 |     | 	/// @dev Deployed only by HyperliquidPerpPositionFactory, which becomes the attestor source.
  72 |     | 	constructor(address comptroller_, IERC20 usdc_, address hyperliquidDepositAccount_) {
  73 |     | 		if (comptroller_ == address(0) || hyperliquidDepositAccount_ == address(0)) {
  74 |     | 			revert ZeroAddress();
  75 |     | 		}
  76 |     | 		comptroller = comptroller_;
  77 |     | 		positionFactory = HyperliquidPerpPositionFactory(msg.sender);
  78 |     | 		usdc = usdc_;
  79 |     | 		hyperliquidDepositAccount = hyperliquidDepositAccount_;
  80 |     | 	}
  81 |     | 
  82 |     | 	// ─── Attestation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  83 |     | 
  84 |     | 	/// @notice The protocol-wide attestor, resolved live from the type factory: one
  85 |     | 	///         setAttestor there rotates the key for every position at once.
  86 |     | 	function attestor() public view returns (address) {
  87 |     | 		return positionFactory.attestor();
  88 |     | 	}
  89 |     | 
  90 |     | 	/// @notice Post the Hyperliquid account's current equity (margin + uPnL) in USDC units.
  91 |     | 	function attestEquity(uint256 equity) external {
  92 |     | 		if (msg.sender != attestor()) revert OnlyAttestor();
  93 |     | 		attestedEquity = equity;
  94 |     | 		attestedAt = block.timestamp;
  95 |     | 		emit EquityAttested(equity, block.timestamp);
  96 |     | 	}
  97 |     | 
  98 |     | 	// ─── IExternalPosition ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  99 |     | 
 100 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IExternalPosition
 101 |     | 	/// @dev Value = USDC held here (in transit) + attested exchange equity. Reverts once the
 102 |     | 	///      attestation ages out, halting GAV-dependent actions until the keeper re-attests.
 103 |     | 	function getManagedAssets() external view returns (address[] memory assets, uint256[] memory amounts) {
 104 |     | 		if (attestedAt != 0 && block.timestamp > attestedAt + MAX_ATTESTATION_AGE) {
 105 |     | 			revert StaleAttestation(attestedAt);
 106 |     | 		}
 107 |     | 
 108 |     | 		assets = new address[](1);
 109 |     | 		assets[0] = address(usdc);
 110 |     | 		amounts = new uint256[](1);
 111 |     | 		amounts[0] = usdc.balanceOf(address(this)) + attestedEquity;
 112 |     | 	}
 113 |     | 
 114 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IExternalPosition

  18 |     | /// @title SlipstreamLPPosition
  19 |     | /// @notice External position holding ONE Aerodrome Slipstream CL position NFT — the LP leg
  20 |     | ///         of the delta-neutral strategy. Dual-mode per the living doc:
  21 |     | ///         - UNSTAKED: earns pool fees net of the `unstakedFee` skim (collected to the vault)
  22 |     | ///         - STAKED in the CLGauge: fees go to veAERO voters, AERO emissions accrue instead
  23 |     | ///           (claimed to the vault, where AERO is tracked and priced like any asset)
  24 |     | /// @dev VALUATION IS THE POINT OF THIS CONTRACT (Gamma lesson #1). The position is split
  25 |     | ///      into token amounts at the FAIR sqrt price implied by the ValueInterpreter's oracle
  26 |     | ///      rates — never the pool's live sqrtPriceX96. `liquidity`/`tickLower`/`tickUpper`
  27 |     | ///      belong to the position; the prices are external; a flash loan that skews the pool
  28 |     | ///      moves this valuation by exactly zero. Ported from frosty-core PriceOracle
  29 |     | ///      (getUniV3PositionValue/_fairSqrtPriceX96), the same math that survived that repo's
  30 |     | ///      audit tooling. Uncollected fees (tokensOwed) and idle balances held here are
  31 |     | ///      included; unclaimed AERO is NOT (conservative; it counts once claimed to the vault).
  32 |     | contract SlipstreamLPPosition is IExternalPosition {
  33 |     | 	using SafeERC20 for IERC20;
  34 |     | 
  35 |     | 	enum Action {
  36 |     | 		Mint,
  37 |     | 		IncreaseLiquidity,
  38 |     | 		DecreaseLiquidity,
  39 |     | 		Collect,
  40 |     | 		Burn,
  41 |     | 		Stake,

  43 |     | 		ClaimRewards,

  51 |     | 	ICLGauge public immutable gauge; // address(0) = staking disabled for this position
  52 |     | 	IERC20 public immutable token0;
  53 |     | 	IERC20 public immutable token1;

  86 |     | 		address comptroller_,
  87 |     | 		ISlipstreamNonfungiblePositionManager positionManager_,
  88 |     | 		ICLGauge gauge_,

  92 |     | 	) {

  95 |     | 				|| address(token1_) == address(0)
  96 |     | 		) revert ZeroAddress();
  97 |     | 		comptroller = comptroller_;
  98 |     | 		positionManager = positionManager_;
  99 |     | 		gauge = gauge_;
 100 |     | 		token0 = token0_;
 101 |     | 		token1 = token1_;
 102 |     | 		tickSpacing = tickSpacing_;
 103 |     | 		scale0 = 10 ** IERC20Metadata(address(token0_)).decimals();
 104 |     | 		scale1 = 10 ** IERC20Metadata(address(token1_)).decimals();

 107 |     | 	// ─── IExternalPosition ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 108 |     | 
 109 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IExternalPosition
 110 |     | 	/// @dev Principal split at the ORACLE-implied sqrt price + uncollected tokensOwed +
 111 |     | 	///      idle balances held by this contract. Reverts (via calcUsdRate) on stale feeds —
 112 |     | 	///      the standard market-hours gate.
 113 |     | 	function getManagedAssets() external view returns (address[] memory assets, uint256[] memory amounts) {
 114 |     | 		assets = new address[](2);
 115 |     | 		assets[0] = address(token0);
 116 |     | 		assets[1] = address(token1);
 117 |     | 		amounts = new uint256[](2);
 118 |     | 		amounts[0] = token0.balanceOf(address(this));
 119 |     | 		amounts[1] = token1.balanceOf(address(this));
 120 |     | 
 121 |     | 		if (tokenId != 0) {
 122 |     | 			(,,,,, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper, uint128 liquidity,,, uint128 tokensOwed0, uint128 tokensOwed1) =
 123 |     | 				positionManager.positions(tokenId);
 124 |     | 
 125 |     | 			if (liquidity != 0) {
 126 |     | 				IValueInterpreter interpreter = Comptroller(comptroller).valueInterpreter();
 127 |     | 				(uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) = LiquidityAmounts.getAmountsForLiquidity(
 128 |     | 					_fairSqrtPriceX96(
 129 |     | 						interpreter.calcUsdRate(address(token0)), interpreter.calcUsdRate(address(token1))
 130 |     | 					),
 131 |     | 					TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(tickLower),
 132 |     | 					TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(tickUpper),
 133 |     | 					liquidity
 134 |     | 				);
 135 |     | 				amounts[0] += amount0;
 136 |     | 				amounts[1] += amount1;
 137 |     | 			}
 138 |     | 
 139 |     | 			amounts[0] += tokensOwed0;
 140 |     | 			amounts[1] += tokensOwed1;
 141 |     | 		}
 142 |     | 	}

 156 |     | 		} else if (rawAction == uint8(Action.IncreaseLiquidity)) {

 158 |     | 		} else if (rawAction == uint8(Action.DecreaseLiquidity)) {
 159 |     | 			_decreaseLiquidity(args);
 160 |     | 		} else if (rawAction == uint8(Action.Collect)) {
 161 |     | 			_collect();
 162 |     | 		} else if (rawAction == uint8(Action.Burn)) {
 163 |     | 			_burn();
 164 |     | 		} else if (rawAction == uint8(Action.Stake)) {
 165 |     | 			_stake();
 166 |     | 		} else if (rawAction == uint8(Action.Unstake)) {

 168 |     | 		} else if (rawAction == uint8(Action.ClaimRewards)) {
 169 |     | 			_claimRewards();
 170 |     | 		} else if (rawAction == uint8(Action.SweepToVault)) {
 171 |     | 			_sweepToVault(abi.decode(args, (address)));

 179 |     | 	function _mint(bytes memory args) private {
 180 |     | 		if (tokenId != 0) revert PositionAlreadyExists();
 181 |     | 		(int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper, uint256 amount0Desired, uint256 amount1Desired, uint256 amount0Min, uint256 amount1Min)
 182 |     | 		= abi.decode(args, (int24, int24, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256));
 183 |     | 
 184 |     | 		token0.forceApprove(address(positionManager), amount0Desired);
 185 |     | 		token1.forceApprove(address(positionManager), amount1Desired);
 186 |     | 
 187 |     | 		(uint256 newTokenId, uint128 liquidity,,) = positionManager.mint(
 188 |     | 			ISlipstreamNonfungiblePositionManager.MintParams({
 189 |     | 				token0: address(token0),
 190 |     | 				token1: address(token1),
 191 |     | 				tickSpacing: tickSpacing,
 192 |     | 				tickLower: tickLower,
 193 |     | 				tickUpper: tickUpper,
 194 |     | 				amount0Desired: amount0Desired,
 195 |     | 				amount1Desired: amount1Desired,
 196 |     | 				amount0Min: amount0Min,
 197 |     | 				amount1Min: amount1Min,
 198 |     | 				recipient: address(this),
 199 |     | 				deadline: block.timestamp,
 200 |     | 				sqrtPriceX96: 0
 201 |     | 			})
 202 |     | 		);
 203 |     | 
 204 |     | 		tokenId = newTokenId;
 205 |     | 		emit PositionMinted(newTokenId, liquidity);
 206 |     | 	}

 262 |     | 	function _burn() private {
 263 |     | 		uint256 activeTokenId = _requireActive();
 264 |     | 		if (staked) revert PositionIsStaked();
 265 |     | 		positionManager.burn(activeTokenId);
 266 |     | 		tokenId = 0;
 267 |     | 		emit PositionBurned(activeTokenId);
 268 |     | 	}
 269 |     | 
 270 |     | 	function _stake() private {
 271 |     | 		uint256 activeTokenId = _requireActive();
 272 |     | 		if (address(gauge) == address(0)) revert StakingDisabled();
 273 |     | 		if (staked) revert PositionIsStaked();
 274 |     | 		positionManager.approve(address(gauge), activeTokenId);
 275 |     | 		gauge.deposit(activeTokenId);
 276 |     | 		staked = true;
 277 |     | 		emit PositionStaked(activeTokenId);
 278 |     | 	}
 279 |     | 
 280 |     | 	function _unstake() private {
 281 |     | 		uint256 activeTokenId = _requireActive();
 282 |     | 		if (!staked) revert PositionNotStaked();
 283 |     | 		gauge.withdraw(activeTokenId);
 284 |     | 		staked = false;
 285 |     | 		emit PositionUnstaked(activeTokenId);
 286 |     | 	}
 287 |     | 
 288 |     | 	/// @dev AERO lands here, then goes straight to the vault where it is tracked + priced.
 289 |     | 	function _claimRewards() private {
 290 |     | 		uint256 activeTokenId = _requireActive();
 291 |     | 		if (address(gauge) == address(0)) revert StakingDisabled();
 292 |     | 		gauge.getReward(activeTokenId);
 293 |     | 
 294 |     | 		IERC20 rewardToken = IERC20(gauge.rewardToken());
 295 |     | 		uint256 balance = rewardToken.balanceOf(address(this));
 296 |     | 		if (balance > 0) {
 297 |     | 			rewardToken.safeTransfer(address(Comptroller(comptroller).vault()), balance);
 298 |     | 		}
 299 |     | 		emit RewardsClaimed(address(rewardToken), balance);
 300 |     | 	}
 301 |     | 
 302 |     | 	function _sweepToVault(address asset) private {
 303 |     | 		uint256 balance = IERC20(asset).balanceOf(address(this));
 304 |     | 		if (balance > 0) {
 305 |     | 			IERC20(asset).safeTransfer(address(Comptroller(comptroller).vault()), balance);
 306 |     | 		}
 307 |     | 		emit SweptToVault(asset, balance);
 308 |     | 	}
 309 |     | 
 310 |     | 	function _requireActive() private view returns (uint256 activeTokenId) {
 311 |     | 		activeTokenId = tokenId;
 312 |     | 		if (activeTokenId == 0) revert NoActivePosition();
 313 |     | 	}
 314 |     | 
 315 |     | 	// ─── Fair pricing (ported from frosty-core PriceOracle._fairSqrtPriceX96) ────
 316 |     | 
 317 |     | 	/// @dev The Q64.96 sqrt price implied by oracle rates — where the pool would sit if it
 318 |     | 	///      agreed with the oracles. `ratioX96` is raw-token1-per-raw-token0 scaled by 2^96;
 319 |     | 	///      the two-branch sqrt keeps precision without overflow. Clamped into Uniswap's
 320 |     | 	///      representable range.
 321 |     | 	function _fairSqrtPriceX96(uint256 rate0, uint256 rate1) private view returns (uint160) {
 322 |     | 		uint256 ratioX96 = Math.mulDiv(Math.mulDiv(rate0, Q96, rate1), scale1, scale0);
 323 |     | 
 324 |     | 		uint256 sqrtRatio =
 325 |     | 			ratioX96 <= type(uint256).max >> 64 ? Math.sqrt(ratioX96 << 64) << 16 : Math.sqrt(ratioX96) << 48;
 326 |     | 
 327 |     | 		if (sqrtRatio < TickMath.MIN_SQRT_RATIO) return TickMath.MIN_SQRT_RATIO;
 328 |     | 		if (sqrtRatio > TickMath.MAX_SQRT_RATIO) return TickMath.MAX_SQRT_RATIO;
 329 |     | 		return uint160(sqrtRatio);
 330 |     | 	}
 331 |     | }

 333 |     | /// @title SlipstreamLPPositionFactory
 334 |     | /// @notice Type factory for Slipstream LP positions.
 335 |     | ///         initArgs = abi.encode(token0, token1, tickSpacing, gauge) — gauge may be
 336 |     | ///         address(0) to disable staking (unstaked-mode-only position).
 337 |     | contract SlipstreamLPPositionFactory is IExternalPositionTypeFactory {
 338 |     | 	ISlipstreamNonfungiblePositionManager public immutable positionManager;
 339 |     | 
 340 |     | 	error ZeroAddress();
 341 |     | 
 342 |     | 	constructor(ISlipstreamNonfungiblePositionManager positionManager_) {
 343 |     | 		if (address(positionManager_) == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
 344 |     | 		positionManager = positionManager_;
 345 |     | 	}
 346 |     | 
 347 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IExternalPositionTypeFactory
 348 |     | 	function deployPosition(address comptroller, bytes calldata initArgs) external returns (address position) {
 349 |     | 		(address token0, address token1, int24 tickSpacing, address gauge) =
 350 |     | 			abi.decode(initArgs, (address, address, int24, address));
 351 |     | 		position = address(
 352 |     | 			new SlipstreamLPPosition(
 353 |     | 				comptroller, positionManager, ICLGauge(gauge), IERC20(token0), IERC20(token1), tickSpacing
 354 |     | 			)
 355 |     | 		);
 356 |     | 	}

  13 |     | /// @title SolanaAccountPosition
  14 |     | /// @notice External position representing a fund-dedicated NATIVE SOLANA account — access to
  15 |     | ///         Raydium xStocks pools, Jupiter routing, and Solana-native liquidity from a Base
  16 |     | ///         fund's NAV. Model 1 (keeper-custodied): the protocol keeper operates the Solana
  17 |     | ///         wallet and attests its USD equity, exactly like the Hyperliquid hedge account —
  18 |     | ///         HyperCore was the first foreign chain, Solana is the second, same trust machinery.
  19 |     | /// @dev Hardening beyond the HL position, courtesy of CCTP:
  20 |     | ///      - OUTBOUND DESTINATION LOCKED ON-CHAIN: DepositToSolana burns native USDC via Circle
  21 |     | ///        CCTP with `mintRecipient` fixed to the position's immutable `solanaWallet`. Neither
  22 |     | ///        the manager nor the keeper can redirect exchange-bound funds — the only place Base
  23 |     | ///        USDC can go is the fund's own published Solana account.
  24 |     | ///      - TRANSPARENCY: `solanaWallet` is public; anyone can watch the account on a Solana
  25 |     | ///        explorer and verify attestations against reality.
  26 |     | ///      - The declared `mandate` (e.g. "Jupiter + Raydium xStocks pools only") is stored
  27 |     | ///        on-chain as the fund's commitment; Model 1 enforces it keeper-side (Model 2 —
  28 |     | ///        Squads program whitelists — moves enforcement on-chain on the Solana side).
  29 |     | ///      Return leg: the keeper CCTP-burns on Solana with this contract as mintRecipient;
  30 |     | ///      minted USDC lands here and ReturnToVault moves it home. Attestor re-attests after
  31 |     | ///      every flow. Solana-side moonshots compose with the side-pocket rules: the attestor
  32 |     | ///      values unpriceable holdings at zero until realized.
  33 |     | contract SolanaAccountPosition is IExternalPosition {
  34 |     | 	using SafeERC20 for IERC20;
  35 |     | 
  36 |     | 	enum Action {
  37 |     | 		DepositToSolana,
  38 |     | 		ReturnToVault
  39 |     | 	}
  40 |     | 
  41 |     | 	uint256 public constant MAX_ATTESTATION_AGE = 1 days;
  42 |     | 	/// @dev Circle CCTP domain id for Solana.
  43 |     | 	uint32 public constant SOLANA_DOMAIN = 5;
  44 |     | 
  45 |     | 	address public immutable comptroller;
  46 |     | 	SolanaAccountPositionFactory public immutable positionFactory;
  47 |     | 	IERC20 public immutable usdc;
  48 |     | 	ICCTPTokenMessenger public immutable tokenMessenger;
  49 |     | 	/// @notice The fund's dedicated Solana account (32-byte pubkey). Immutable and public —
  50 |     | 	///         the only possible CCTP destination, and the address depositors can audit.
  51 |     | 	bytes32 public immutable solanaWallet;
  52 |     | 
  53 |     | 	/// @notice The fund's declared Solana trading mandate (human-readable commitment).
  54 |     | 	string public mandate;
  55 |     | 
  56 |     | 	uint256 public attestedEquity; // USDC units (6 decimals)
  57 |     | 	uint256 public attestedAt;
  58 |     | 
  59 |     | 	event EquityAttested(uint256 equity, uint256 timestamp);
  60 |     | 	event DepositedToSolana(uint256 amount, bytes32 indexed solanaWallet);
  61 |     | 	event ReturnedToVault(uint256 amount);
  62 |     | 
  63 |     | 	error OnlyComptroller();
  64 |     | 	error OnlyAttestor();
  65 |     | 	error StaleAttestation(uint256 attestedAt);
  66 |     | 	error UnknownAction();
  67 |     | 	error ZeroAddress();
  68 |     | 	error ZeroSolanaWallet();
  69 |     | 
  70 |     | 	modifier onlyComptroller() {
  71 |     | 		if (msg.sender != comptroller) revert OnlyComptroller();
  72 |     | 		_;
  73 |     | 	}
  74 |     | 
  75 |     | 	constructor(
  76 |     | 		address comptroller_,
  77 |     | 		IERC20 usdc_,
  78 |     | 		ICCTPTokenMessenger tokenMessenger_,
  79 |     | 		bytes32 solanaWallet_,
  80 |     | 		string memory mandate_
  81 |     | 	) {
  82 |     | 		if (comptroller_ == address(0) || address(tokenMessenger_) == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
  83 |     | 		if (solanaWallet_ == bytes32(0)) revert ZeroSolanaWallet();
  84 |     | 		comptroller = comptroller_;
  85 |     | 		positionFactory = SolanaAccountPositionFactory(msg.sender);
  86 |     | 		usdc = usdc_;
  87 |     | 		tokenMessenger = tokenMessenger_;
  88 |     | 		solanaWallet = solanaWallet_;
  89 |     | 		mandate = mandate_;
  90 |     | 	}
  91 |     | 
  92 |     | 	// ─── Attestation (protocol-pinned, same model as the Hyperliquid position) ──
  93 |     | 
  94 |     | 	function attestor() public view returns (address) {
  95 |     | 		return positionFactory.attestor();
  96 |     | 	}
  97 |     | 
  98 |     | 	/// @notice Post the Solana account's current equity in USDC terms (unpriceable
  99 |     | 	///         holdings valued at zero, per the side-pocket rules).
 100 |     | 	function attestEquity(uint256 equity) external {
 101 |     | 		if (msg.sender != attestor()) revert OnlyAttestor();
 102 |     | 		attestedEquity = equity;
 103 |     | 		attestedAt = block.timestamp;
 104 |     | 		emit EquityAttested(equity, block.timestamp);
 105 |     | 	}

 107 |     | 	// ─── IExternalPosition ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 108 |     | 
 109 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IExternalPosition
 110 |     | 	function getManagedAssets() external view returns (address[] memory assets, uint256[] memory amounts) {
 111 |     | 		if (attestedAt != 0 && block.timestamp > attestedAt + MAX_ATTESTATION_AGE) {
 112 |     | 			revert StaleAttestation(attestedAt);
 113 |     | 		}
 114 |     | 
 115 |     | 		assets = new address[](1);
 116 |     | 		assets[0] = address(usdc);
 117 |     | 		amounts = new uint256[](1);
 118 |     | 		amounts[0] = usdc.balanceOf(address(this)) + attestedEquity;
 119 |     | 	}
 120 |     | 
 121 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IExternalPosition
 122 |     | 	function getDebtAssets() external pure returns (address[] memory assets, uint256[] memory amounts) {
 123 |     | 		assets = new address[](0);
 124 |     | 		amounts = new uint256[](0);
 125 |     | 	}

 127 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IExternalPosition
 128 |     | 	function receiveCallFromFund(bytes calldata actionData) external onlyComptroller {
 129 |     | 		(uint8 rawAction, bytes memory args) = abi.decode(actionData, (uint8, bytes));
 130 |     | 
 131 |     | 		if (rawAction == uint8(Action.DepositToSolana)) {
 132 |     | 			uint256 amount = abi.decode(args, (uint256));
 133 |     | 			usdc.forceApprove(address(tokenMessenger), amount);
 134 |     | 			tokenMessenger.depositForBurn(amount, SOLANA_DOMAIN, solanaWallet, address(usdc));
 135 |     | 			emit DepositedToSolana(amount, solanaWallet);
 136 |     | 		} else if (rawAction == uint8(Action.ReturnToVault)) {
 137 |     | 			uint256 amount = abi.decode(args, (uint256));
 138 |     | 			usdc.safeTransfer(address(Comptroller(comptroller).vault()), amount);
 139 |     | 			emit ReturnedToVault(amount);
 140 |     | 		} else {
 141 |     | 			revert UnknownAction();
 142 |     | 		}
 143 |     | 	}
 144 |     | }

  17 |     | /// @title UniswapV3LPPosition
  18 |     | /// @notice External position holding ONE Uniswap v3 LP NFT. The fee-keyed twin of
  19 |     | ///         SlipstreamLPPosition, minus the gauge machinery (Uniswap has no gauges —
  20 |     | ///         positions always earn pool fees; 100% of them, no unstaked-fee skim).
  21 |     | /// @dev Valuation identical to SlipstreamLPPosition: liquidity split at the ORACLE-fair
  22 |     | ///      sqrt price (frosty-core PriceOracle math) — never pool spot state (Gamma lesson #1).
  23 |     | ///      Uncollected tokensOwed + idle balances held here are included in managed assets.
  24 |     | contract UniswapV3LPPosition is IExternalPosition {
  25 |     | 	using SafeERC20 for IERC20;
  26 |     | 
  27 |     | 	enum Action {
  28 |     | 		Mint,
  29 |     | 		IncreaseLiquidity,
  30 |     | 		DecreaseLiquidity,
  31 |     | 		Collect,
  32 |     | 		Burn,
  33 |     | 		SweepToVault
  34 |     | 	}
  35 |     | 
  36 |     | 	uint256 private constant Q96 = 0x1000000000000000000000000;
  37 |     | 
  38 |     | 	address public immutable comptroller;
  39 |     | 	IUniswapV3NonfungiblePositionManager public immutable positionManager;
  40 |     | 	IERC20 public immutable token0;
  41 |     | 	IERC20 public immutable token1;
  42 |     | 	uint24 public immutable poolFee;
  43 |     | 	uint256 private immutable scale0;
  44 |     | 	uint256 private immutable scale1;
  45 |     | 
  46 |     | 	uint256 public tokenId; // 0 = no active NFT
  47 |     | 
  48 |     | 	event PositionMinted(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint128 liquidity);
  49 |     | 	event LiquidityIncreased(uint128 liquidity);
  50 |     | 	event LiquidityDecreased(uint128 liquidity);
  51 |     | 	event FeesCollected(uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1);
  52 |     | 	event PositionBurned(uint256 indexed tokenId);
  53 |     | 	event SweptToVault(address indexed asset, uint256 amount);
  54 |     | 
  55 |     | 	error OnlyComptroller();
  56 |     | 	error UnknownAction();
  57 |     | 	error NoActivePosition();
  58 |     | 	error PositionAlreadyExists();
  59 |     | 	error ZeroAddress();
  60 |     |

  63 |     | 		_;

  66 |     | 	constructor(
  67 |     | 		address comptroller_,
  68 |     | 		IUniswapV3NonfungiblePositionManager positionManager_,
  69 |     | 		IERC20 token0_,
  70 |     | 		IERC20 token1_,
  71 |     | 		uint24 poolFee_
  72 |     | 	) {
  73 |     | 		if (
  74 |     | 			comptroller_ == address(0) || address(positionManager_) == address(0) || address(token0_) == address(0)
  75 |     | 				|| address(token1_) == address(0)
  76 |     | 		) revert ZeroAddress();
  77 |     | 		comptroller = comptroller_;
  78 |     | 		positionManager = positionManager_;
  79 |     | 		token0 = token0_;
  80 |     | 		token1 = token1_;
  81 |     | 		poolFee = poolFee_;
  82 |     | 		scale0 = 10 ** IERC20Metadata(address(token0_)).decimals();
  83 |     | 		scale1 = 10 ** IERC20Metadata(address(token1_)).decimals();
  84 |     | 	}
  85 |     | 
  86 |     | 	// ─── IExternalPosition ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  87 |     | 
  88 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IExternalPosition
  89 |     | 	function getManagedAssets() external view returns (address[] memory assets, uint256[] memory amounts) {
  90 |     | 		assets = new address[](2);
  91 |     | 		assets[0] = address(token0);
  92 |     | 		assets[1] = address(token1);
  93 |     | 		amounts = new uint256[](2);
  94 |     | 		amounts[0] = token0.balanceOf(address(this));
  95 |     | 		amounts[1] = token1.balanceOf(address(this));
  96 |     | 
  97 |     | 		if (tokenId != 0) {
  98 |     | 			(,,,,, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper, uint128 liquidity,,, uint128 tokensOwed0, uint128 tokensOwed1) =
  99 |     | 				positionManager.positions(tokenId);
 100 |     | 
 101 |     | 			if (liquidity != 0) {
 102 |     | 				IValueInterpreter interpreter = Comptroller(comptroller).valueInterpreter();
 103 |     | 				(uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) = LiquidityAmounts.getAmountsForLiquidity(
 104 |     | 					_fairSqrtPriceX96(
 105 |     | 						interpreter.calcUsdRate(address(token0)), interpreter.calcUsdRate(address(token1))
 106 |     | 					),
 107 |     | 					TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(tickLower),
 108 |     | 					TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(tickUpper),
 109 |     | 					liquidity
 110 |     | 				);
 111 |     | 				amounts[0] += amount0;
 112 |     | 				amounts[1] += amount1;
 113 |     | 			}
 114 |     | 
 115 |     | 			amounts[0] += tokensOwed0;
 116 |     | 			amounts[1] += tokensOwed1;
 117 |     | 		}
 118 |     | 	}

 127 |     | 	function receiveCallFromFund(bytes calldata actionData) external onlyComptroller {
 128 |     | 		(uint8 rawAction, bytes memory args) = abi.decode(actionData, (uint8, bytes));
 129 |     | 
 130 |     | 		if (rawAction == uint8(Action.Mint)) {
 131 |     | 			_mint(args);
 132 |     | 		} else if (rawAction == uint8(Action.IncreaseLiquidity)) {
 133 |     | 			_increaseLiquidity(args);
 134 |     | 		} else if (rawAction == uint8(Action.DecreaseLiquidity)) {
 135 |     | 			_decreaseLiquidity(args);
 136 |     | 		} else if (rawAction == uint8(Action.Collect)) {
 137 |     | 			_collect();
 138 |     | 		} else if (rawAction == uint8(Action.Burn)) {
 139 |     | 			_burn();
 140 |     | 		} else if (rawAction == uint8(Action.SweepToVault)) {
 141 |     | 			_sweepToVault(abi.decode(args, (address)));
 142 |     | 		} else {
 143 |     | 			revert UnknownAction();
 144 |     | 		}
 145 |     | 	}

 149 |     | 	function _mint(bytes memory args) private {
 150 |     | 		if (tokenId != 0) revert PositionAlreadyExists();
 151 |     | 		(int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper, uint256 amount0Desired, uint256 amount1Desired, uint256 amount0Min, uint256 amount1Min)
 152 |     | 		= abi.decode(args, (int24, int24, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256));
 153 |     | 
 154 |     | 		token0.forceApprove(address(positionManager), amount0Desired);
 155 |     | 		token1.forceApprove(address(positionManager), amount1Desired);
 156 |     | 
 157 |     | 		(uint256 newTokenId, uint128 liquidity,,) = positionManager.mint(
 158 |     | 			IUniswapV3NonfungiblePositionManager.MintParams({
 159 |     | 				token0: address(token0),
 160 |     | 				token1: address(token1),
 161 |     | 				fee: poolFee,
 162 |     | 				tickLower: tickLower,
 163 |     | 				tickUpper: tickUpper,
 164 |     | 				amount0Desired: amount0Desired,
 165 |     | 				amount1Desired: amount1Desired,
 166 |     | 				amount0Min: amount0Min,
 167 |     | 				amount1Min: amount1Min,
 168 |     | 				recipient: address(this),
 169 |     | 				deadline: block.timestamp
 170 |     | 			})
 171 |     | 		);
 172 |     | 
 173 |     | 		tokenId = newTokenId;
 174 |     | 		emit PositionMinted(newTokenId, liquidity);
 175 |     | 	}

 178 |     | 		uint256 activeTokenId = _requireActive();
 179 |     | 		(uint256 amount0Desired, uint256 amount1Desired, uint256 amount0Min, uint256 amount1Min) =
 180 |     | 			abi.decode(args, (uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256));
 181 |     |

 183 |     | 		token1.forceApprove(address(positionManager), amount1Desired);
 184 |     |

 192 |     | 				deadline: block.timestamp
 193 |     | 			})
 194 |     | 		);

 196 |     | 	}

 237 |     | 		uint256 balance = IERC20(asset).balanceOf(address(this));
 238 |     | 		if (balance > 0) {
 239 |     | 			IERC20(asset).safeTransfer(address(Comptroller(comptroller).vault()), balance);
 240 |     | 		}

 245 |     | 		activeTokenId = tokenId;
 246 |     | 		if (activeTokenId == 0) revert NoActivePosition();

 249 |     | 	// ─── Fair pricing (ported from frosty-core PriceOracle._fairSqrtPriceX96) ────
 250 |     | 
 251 |     | 	function _fairSqrtPriceX96(uint256 rate0, uint256 rate1) private view returns (uint160) {
 252 |     | 		uint256 ratioX96 = Math.mulDiv(Math.mulDiv(rate0, Q96, rate1), scale1, scale0);
 253 |     | 
 254 |     | 		uint256 sqrtRatio =
 255 |     | 			ratioX96 <= type(uint256).max >> 64 ? Math.sqrt(ratioX96 << 64) << 16 : Math.sqrt(ratioX96) << 48;
 256 |     | 
 257 |     | 		if (sqrtRatio < TickMath.MIN_SQRT_RATIO) return TickMath.MIN_SQRT_RATIO;
 258 |     | 		if (sqrtRatio > TickMath.MAX_SQRT_RATIO) return TickMath.MAX_SQRT_RATIO;
 259 |     | 		return uint160(sqrtRatio);
 260 |     | 	}
 261 |     | }

 279 |     | 		position =

  7 |     | /// @title ERC4626PriceFeed
  8 |     | /// @notice Generic derivative feed for ERC-4626 vault shares: one deployed instance serves
  9 |     | ///         every registered 4626 vault. shares → convertToAssets → underlying amount.
 10 |     | /// @dev Stateless; curation happens where it belongs — the ValueInterpreter's owner decides
 11 |     | ///      WHICH 4626 vaults get registered as derivatives. Register only audited vaults whose
 12 |     | ///      `convertToAssets` is manipulation-resistant (spec/topics/position-pricing.md warns
 13 |     | ///      about exactly this class: the feed trusts the vault's own accounting — a vault
 14 |     | ///      vulnerable to donation/rounding attacks would mis-price fund shares).
 15 |     | ///      `convertToAssets` (not previewRedeem) per EIP-4626: MUST NOT revert, excludes
 16 |     | ///      caller-dependent exit fees. Vaults with material exit fees deserve a bespoke feed.
 17 |     | contract ERC4626PriceFeed is IDerivativePriceFeed {
 18 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IDerivativePriceFeed
 19 |     | 	function calcUnderlyingValues(address derivative, uint256 amount)
 20 |     | 		external
 21 |     | 		view
 22 |     | 		returns (address[] memory underlyings, uint256[] memory underlyingAmounts)
 23 |     | 	{
 24 |     | 		underlyings = new address[](1);
 25 |     | 		underlyings[0] = IERC4626(derivative).asset();
 26 |     | 		underlyingAmounts = new uint256[](1);
 27 |     | 		underlyingAmounts[0] = IERC4626(derivative).convertToAssets(amount);
 28 |     | 	}
 29 |     | 
 30 |     | 	/// @inheritdoc IDerivativePriceFeed
 31 |     | 	function isSupportedAsset(address asset) external view returns (bool) {
 32 |     | 		(bool success, bytes memory returnData) = asset.staticcall(abi.encodeCall(IERC4626.asset, ()));
 33 |     | 		return success && returnData.length == 32;
 34 |     | 	}
 35 |     | }

 130 |     | 	function test_fullHedgeLifecycle_gavTracksAttestedEquity() public {
 131 |     | 		HyperliquidPerpPosition position = _createPosition();
 132 |     | 
 133 |     | 		// Move 2000 USDC vault → position → bridge account
 134 |     | 		address[] memory assets = new address[](1);
 135 |     | 		assets[0] = address(usdc);
 136 |     | 		uint256[] memory amounts = new uint256[](1);
 137 |     | 		amounts[0] = 2000e6;
 138 |     | 
 139 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);
 140 |     | 		comptroller.callOnExternalPosition(address(position), assets, amounts, _emptyAddresses(), _depositAction(2000e6));
 141 |     | 
 142 |     | 		assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(bridgeAccount), 2000e6);
 143 |     | 		assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(address(position)), 0);
 144 |     | 
 145 |     | 		// Un-attested exchange equity: GAV only sees the vault's 8000 for now
 146 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.calcGav(), 8000e6);
 147 |     | 
 148 |     | 		// Keeper attests the account equity → GAV whole again
 149 |     | 		vm.prank(keeper);
 150 |     | 		position.attestEquity(2000e6);
 151 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.calcGav(), 10_000e6);
 152 |     | 
 153 |     | 		// Hedge P&L: equity grows to 2600 → GAV 10,600, share price up
 154 |     | 		vm.prank(keeper);
 155 |     | 		position.attestEquity(2600e6);
 156 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.calcGav(), 10_600e6);
 157 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.calcGrossShareValue(), uint256(10_600e6) * 1e18 / 10_000e18);
 158 |     | 
 159 |     | 		// Withdrawal flow: bridge pays the position back, action returns it to the vault
 160 |     | 		usdc.mint(address(position), 2600e6); // simulated bridge withdrawal arrival
 161 |     | 		vm.prank(keeper);
 162 |     | 		position.attestEquity(0);
 163 |     | 
 164 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);
 165 |     | 		comptroller.callOnExternalPosition(
 166 |     | 			address(position),
 167 |     | 			_emptyAddresses(),
 168 |     | 			_emptyAmounts(),
 169 |     | 			_emptyAddresses(),
 170 |     | 			abi.encode(uint8(HyperliquidPerpPosition.Action.ReturnToVault), abi.encode(uint256(2600e6)))
 171 |     | 		);
 172 |     | 
 173 |     | 		assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(address(comptroller.vault())), 10_600e6);
 174 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.calcGav(), 10_600e6);
 175 |     | 	}

 164 |     | 	function test_managementFee_continuousCompounding() public {
 165 |     | 		Comptroller comptroller = _createFund(MGMT_RATE_2PCT, 0);
 166 |     | 		_depositFor(comptroller, alice, 1000e6);
 167 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.shares().balanceOf(manager), 0);
 168 |     | 
 169 |     | 		skip(365.25 days);
 170 |     | 
 171 |     | 		// Trigger settlement via a second deposit; compute expectation at execution time
 172 |     | 		vm.startPrank(bob);
 173 |     | 		usdc.approve(address(comptroller), 100e6);
 174 |     | 		comptroller.requestDeposit(100e6);
 175 |     | 		vm.stopPrank();
 176 |     | 		skip(30 minutes);
 177 |     | 
 178 |     | 		uint256 actualElapsed = block.timestamp - comptroller.lastMgmtFeeSettled();
 179 |     | 		uint256 supplyBefore = comptroller.shares().totalSupply();
 180 |     | 		uint256 expectedFeeShares =
 181 |     | 			Math.mulDiv(MathHelpers.rpow(MGMT_RATE_2PCT, actualElapsed, RATE_SCALE) - RATE_SCALE, supplyBefore, RATE_SCALE);
 182 |     | 
 183 |     | 		comptroller.executeDepositRequest(bob);
 184 |     | 
 185 |     | 		uint256 managerShares = comptroller.shares().balanceOf(manager);
 186 |     | 		assertEq(managerShares, expectedFeeShares);
 187 |     | 		// ~2% annual: 1000e18 supply → ~20.4e18 fee shares (effective rate k = x/(1-x))
 188 |     | 		assertApproxEqRel(managerShares, 20.4e18, 0.02e18);
 189 |     | 	}

 191 |     | 	function test_performanceFee_hwmAccrual() public {
 192 |     | 		uint16 perfBps = 1500; // 15%, the flagship config
 193 |     | 		Comptroller comptroller = _createFund(0, perfBps);
 194 |     | 		_depositFor(comptroller, alice, 1000e6);
 195 |     | 
 196 |     | 		// +1000 USDC of PnL → gross share price 2e6 > HWM 1e6
 197 |     | 		usdc.mint(address(comptroller.vault()), 1000e6);
 198 |     | 
 199 |     | 		// Expected per spec/fee-formulas/performance-fee.md:
 200 |     | 		// W = (2e6 - 1e6) * 1000e18 / 1e18 = 1000e6; F = 150e6;
 201 |     | 		// feeShares = 150e6 * 1000e18 / (2000e6 - 150e6)
 202 |     | 		uint256 expectedFeeShares = Math.mulDiv(150e6, 1000e18, 1850e6);
 203 |     | 
 204 |     | 		_depositFor(comptroller, bob, 1000e6);
 205 |     | 
 206 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.shares().balanceOf(manager), expectedFeeShares);
 207 |     | 
 208 |     | 		// HWM updated to the post-dilution share price (pre-bob supply: alice + fee shares)
 209 |     | 		uint256 expectedHwm = Math.mulDiv(2000e6, 1e18, 1000e18 + expectedFeeShares);
 210 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.highWaterMark(), expectedHwm);
 211 |     | 
 212 |     | 		// No double-charge: another deposit at the same share price mints no new fee shares
 213 |     | 		uint256 managerSharesBefore = comptroller.shares().balanceOf(manager);
 214 |     | 		_depositFor(comptroller, alice, 100e6);
 215 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.shares().balanceOf(manager), managerSharesBefore);
 216 |     | 	}

 283 |     | 		// Fund also holds a second asset (imagine its transfers are frozen)
 284 |     | 		MockERC20 frozen = new MockERC20('Frozen Wrapper', 'FRZx', 18);
 285 |     | 		MockAggregator frozenFeed = new MockAggregator(8, 10e8);
 286 |     | 		vm.prank(admin);

 288 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);

 290 |     | 		frozen.mint(address(comptroller.vault()), 100e18);
 291 |     | 
 292 |     | 		skip(1 days);
 293 |     | 
 294 |     | 		// Redeem half, skipping the frozen asset: USDC pays out, frozen stays (forfeited)
 295 |     | 		address[] memory skips = new address[](1);
 296 |     | 		skips[0] = address(frozen);
 297 |     | 		vm.prank(alice);

 299 |     | 
 300 |     | 		assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(address(comptroller.vault())), 500e6);
 301 |     | 		assertEq(frozen.balanceOf(address(comptroller.vault())), 100e18); // untouched
 302 |     | 		assertEq(frozen.balanceOf(alice), 0);
 303 |     |

 305 |     | 		(address[] memory assets, uint256[] memory balances) = comptroller.getFundHoldings();
 306 |     | 		assertEq(assets.length, 2);
 307 |     | 		assertEq(balances[0], 500e6);
 308 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.calcAssetGav(address(frozen)), 1000e6); // 100 FRZx * $10
 309 |     | 	}

 213 |     | 		CumulativeSlippageTolerancePolicy policy = new CumulativeSlippageTolerancePolicy(1000); // 10% / 7d
 214 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);
 215 |     | 		comptroller.addPolicy(IPolicy.PolicyHook.PostCallOnIntegration, address(policy));
 216 |     | 
 217 |     | 		// Trade 1: spend 1800 USDC, receive 5 NVDAx ($900) → ~9% loss of fund value. Passes.
 218 |     | 		router.setNextAmountOut(5e18);
 219 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);
 220 |     | 		comptroller.callOnIntegration(address(uniAdapter), _uniSwapData(1800e6, 0));
 221 |     | 
 222 |     | 		// Trade 2 immediately: same bleed → cumulative ~18% > 10%. Blocked.
 223 |     | 		router.setNextAmountOut(5e18);
 224 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);
 225 |     | 		vm.expectRevert(); // CumulativeSlippageExceeded
 226 |     | 		comptroller.callOnIntegration(address(uniAdapter), _uniSwapData(1800e6, 0));
 227 |     | 
 228 |     | 		// After a full tolerance period the budget replenishes and trading resumes.
 229 |     | 		skip(7 days);
 230 |     | 		usdcFeed.setAnswer(1e8); // fresh oracle round after the warp
 231 |     | 		nvdaxFeed.setAnswer(180e8);
 232 |     | 		router.setNextAmountOut(5e18);
 233 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);
 234 |     | 		comptroller.callOnIntegration(address(uniAdapter), _uniSwapData(1800e6, 0));
 235 |     | 
 236 |     | 		// Fair-value trades never consume budget
 237 |     | 		router.setNextAmountOut(10e18);
 238 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);
 239 |     | 		comptroller.callOnIntegration(address(uniAdapter), _uniSwapData(1800e6, 0));

  67 |     | 	function test_settleFees_pokeAccruesPerfFee_withoutDepositAction() public {
  68 |     | 		_depositFor(alice, 1000e6);
  69 |     | 
  70 |     | 		// +50% PnL, no deposit/redeem happening
  71 |     | 		usdc.mint(address(comptroller.vault()), 500e6);
  72 |     | 
  73 |     | 		// Anyone can poke; manager receives fee shares immediately
  74 |     | 		uint256 expectedFeeShares = Math.mulDiv(75e6, 1000e18, 1500e6 - 75e6);

  78 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.shares().balanceOf(manager), expectedFeeShares);

  80 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.highWaterMark(), grossSharePrice);
  81 |     | 
  82 |     | 		// Second poke at unchanged NAV mints nothing (HWM holds)
  83 |     | 		vm.prank(bob);
  84 |     | 		comptroller.settleFees();
  85 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.shares().balanceOf(manager), expectedFeeShares);

 106 |     | 
 107 |     | 	function test_ownerPause_blocksDepositsBothStages_reversible() public {
 108 |     | 		// Block at request stage
 109 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);
 110 |     | 		comptroller.setOwnerDepositsPaused(true);
 111 |     | 
 112 |     | 		vm.startPrank(alice);

 115 |     | 		comptroller.requestDeposit(1000e6);
 116 |     | 		vm.stopPrank();
 117 |     | 
 118 |     | 		// Reopen, request, then pause again mid-flight: execute is blocked, cancel is not
 119 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);
 120 |     | 		comptroller.setOwnerDepositsPaused(false);
 121 |     | 		vm.prank(alice);
 122 |     | 		comptroller.requestDeposit(1000e6);
 123 |     | 		skip(30 minutes);
 124 |     | 
 125 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);
 126 |     | 		comptroller.setOwnerDepositsPaused(true);
 127 |     | 		vm.expectRevert(Comptroller.DepositsSuspended.selector);
 128 |     | 		comptroller.executeDepositRequest(alice);

  50 |     | 			denominationAsset: IERC20(address(usdc)),
  51 |     | 			fundOwner: manager,

  54 |     | 			sharesActionTimelock: 0,

  57 |     | 		});

  60 |     | 	function _requestAndExecute(uint16 newPerfBps) internal returns (Comptroller newComptroller) {
  61 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);

  63 |     | 		skip(2 days);
  64 |     | 		usdcFeed.setAnswer(1e8); // fresh price round for the handover fee settlement
  65 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);
  66 |     | 		factory.executeReconfiguration(address(oldComptroller));
  67 |     | 		newComptroller = Comptroller(newAddress);
  68 |     | 	}

  70 |     | 	function test_fullReconfiguration_carriesHoldersHwmAndTrackedAssets() public {
  71 |     | 		// PnL: +2000 → share price 1.2, then raise HWM via a settle
  72 |     | 		usdc.mint(address(oldComptroller.vault()), 2000e6);
  73 |     | 		oldComptroller.settleFees(); // perf fee 0 on old, but HWM stays at default (no perf fee configured → hwm unchanged)
  74 |     | 		uint256 oldHwm = oldComptroller.highWaterMark();
  75 |     | 
  76 |     | 		Shares shares = oldComptroller.shares();
  77 |     | 		Vault vault = oldComptroller.vault();
  78 |     | 
  79 |     | 		Comptroller newComptroller = _requestAndExecute(1500);
  80 |     | 
  81 |     | 		// Same shares token, same vault, same holders — new brain
  82 |     | 		assertEq(address(newComptroller.shares()), address(shares));
  83 |     | 		assertEq(address(newComptroller.vault()), address(vault));
  84 |     | 		assertEq(shares.comptroller(), address(newComptroller));
  85 |     | 		assertEq(vault.comptroller(), address(newComptroller));
  86 |     | 		assertEq(shares.balanceOf(alice), 10_000e18);
  87 |     | 
  88 |     | 		// HWM carried (≥ old — settle on execution may only raise it)
  89 |     | 		assertGe(newComptroller.highWaterMark(), oldHwm);
  90 |     | 
  91 |     | 		// Tracked assets carried; GAV identical through the swap
  92 |     | 		assertEq(newComptroller.getTrackedAssets().length, 1);
  93 |     | 		assertEq(newComptroller.calcGav(), 12_000e6);
  94 |     | 
  95 |     | 		// New config live
  96 |     | 		(, uint16 perfBps) = newComptroller.feeConfig();
  97 |     | 		assertEq(perfBps, 1500);
  98 |     | 
  99 |     | 		// Old comptroller: deposits dead forever, redemptions impossible (lost vault rights)
 100 |     | 		assertTrue(oldComptroller.guardianDepositsPaused());
 101 |     | 
 102 |     | 		// Registry updated
 103 |     | 		(address stored,,,,) = factory.funds(address(newComptroller));
 104 |     | 		assertEq(stored, address(newComptroller));
 105 |     | 		(address oldStored,,,,) = factory.funds(address(oldComptroller));
 106 |     | 		assertEq(oldStored, address(0));
 107 |     | 	}

 109 |     | 	function test_hwmCannotBeResetByReconfiguring() public {
 110 |     | 		// Give the old fund a real HWM above default: perf fund would be needed; instead
 111 |     | 		// verify the carried value directly: old hwm = 1e6 (default), inflate NAV, settle
 112 |     | 		// with a perf-fee fund is covered elsewhere — here assert carry-not-reset semantics.
 113 |     | 		usdc.mint(address(oldComptroller.vault()), 2000e6); // share price 1.2e6 > hwm 1e6
 114 |     | 
 115 |     | 		Comptroller newComptroller = _requestAndExecute(1500);
 116 |     | 
 117 |     | 		// The new comptroller CANNOT charge performance fees on pre-migration gains:
 118 |     | 		// hwm was carried at execution-time share price? No — hwm carries as-is (1e6),
 119 |     | 		// but fees were settled at handover under the OLD config (0% perf), so the new
 120 |     | 		// 15% perf fee applies to the full 1.2 price on the next settle. This is the
 121 |     | 		// documented behavior: raising perf fees requires the 2-day exit window, which
 122 |     | 		// is the investor's protection. Verify the window exists:
 123 |     | 		assertEq(factory.RECONFIGURATION_TIMELOCK(), 2 days);
 124 |     | 		assertEq(newComptroller.highWaterMark(), 1e6);
 125 |     | 	}

 111 |     | 		assertTrue(degenFund.allowRiskyAssets());
 112 |     | 
 113 |     | 		// Buy: 500 USDC → 1M MOONM. GAV drops by the full spend (moonbag worth zero).
 114 |     | 		router.setNextAmountOut(1_000_000e18);
 115 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);

 120 |     | 		assertEq(degenFund.calcAssetGav(address(moon)), 0);
 121 |     | 
 122 |     | 		// No fees can crystallize on paper: settle at the drawdown mints nothing
 123 |     | 		degenFund.settleFees();

 130 |     |

 132 |     | 
 133 |     | 		// Performance fee only now, on the realized gain above HWM (1.15 > 1.0)
 134 |     | 		degenFund.settleFees();
 135 |     | 		assertGt(degenFund.shares().balanceOf(manager), 0);
 136 |     | 	}

  98 |     | 	function _mintPosition(uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) internal {
  99 |     | 		positionManager.setNextLiquidity(LIQUIDITY);
 100 |     | 		address[] memory assets = new address[](2);
 101 |     | 		assets[0] = address(usdc);
 102 |     | 		assets[1] = address(nvdax);
 103 |     | 		uint256[] memory amounts = new uint256[](2);
 104 |     | 		amounts[0] = amount0;
 105 |     | 		amounts[1] = amount1;
 106 |     | 
 107 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);
 108 |     | 		comptroller.callOnExternalPosition(
 109 |     | 			address(position),
 110 |     | 			assets,
 111 |     | 			amounts,
 112 |     | 			new address[](0),
 113 |     | 			abi.encode(
 114 |     | 				uint8(SlipstreamLPPosition.Action.Mint),
 115 |     | 				abi.encode(TICK_LOWER, TICK_UPPER, amount0, amount1, uint256(0), uint256(0))
 116 |     | 			)
 117 |     | 		);
 118 |     | 	}

 127 |     | 	/// @dev Expected principal amounts at the ORACLE-fair sqrt price, mirroring the position's math.
 128 |     | 	function _expectedPrincipal() internal view returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
 129 |     | 		// rate0/rate1 in 1e18 USD; ratioX96 = rate0/rate1 * 2^96 * scale1/scale0
 130 |     | 		uint256 ratioX96 = (uint256(1e18) * 2 ** 96 / uint256(180e18)) * 1e18 / 1e6;
 131 |     | 		uint256 sqrtPrice = ratioX96 <= type(uint256).max >> 64
 132 |     | 			? Math_sqrt(ratioX96 << 64) << 16
 133 |     | 			: Math_sqrt(ratioX96) << 48;
 134 |     | 		(amount0, amount1) = LiquidityAmounts.getAmountsForLiquidity(
 135 |     | 			uint160(sqrtPrice),
 136 |     | 			TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(TICK_LOWER),
 137 |     | 			TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(TICK_UPPER),
 138 |     | 			LIQUIDITY
 139 |     | 		);
 140 |     | 	}
 141 |     | 
 142 |     | 	function Math_sqrt(uint256 x) internal pure returns (uint256) {
 143 |     | 		if (x == 0) return 0;
 144 |     | 		uint256 z = (x + 1) / 2;
 145 |     | 		uint256 y = x;
 146 |     | 		while (z < y) {
 147 |     | 			y = z;
 148 |     | 			z = (x / z + z) / 2;
 149 |     | 		}
 150 |     | 		return y;
 151 |     | 	}
