 155 |     | 	function test_positionValuedAtOracleFairPrice_notPoolState() public {
 156 |     | 		uint256 gavBefore = comptroller.calcGav(); // 10,000 USDC + 20 NVDAx * 180 = 13,600e6
 157 |     | 		assertEq(gavBefore, 13_600e6);
 158 |     | 
 159 |     | 		_mintPosition(1800e6, 10e18);
 160 |     | 
 161 |     | 		// Vault paid out 1800 USDC + 10 NVDAx; position re-valued at the SAME oracle prices
 162 |     | 		(uint256 expected0, uint256 expected1) = _expectedPrincipal();
 163 |     | 		uint256 positionValue = expected0 + (expected1 * 180e6) / 1e18;
 164 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.calcGav(), 13_600e6 - 1800e6 - 1800e6 + positionValue);
 165 |     | 
 166 |     | 		// Only ORACLE prices move the valuation. NVDAx +10%:
 167 |     | 		nvdaxFeed.setAnswer(198e8);
 168 |     | 		uint256 gavAfterPump = comptroller.calcGav();
 169 |     | 		assertGt(gavAfterPump, comptroller.defaultSharePrice()); // sanity: GAV recomputed, no revert
 170 |     | 		// (There is no pool state in this valuation to manipulate — liquidity/ticks are the
 171 |     | 		//  position's own, prices are the oracle's. That is the whole design.)
 172 |     | 	}

 118 |     | 	function test_mintValueAndFeeKeying() public {
 119 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.calcGav(), 13_600e6);
 120 |     | 		_mintPosition(1800e6, 10e18);
 121 |     | 
 122 |     | 		// Fee key recorded by the canonical manager
 123 |     | 		(,,,, uint24 fee,,,,,,,) = positionManager.positions(position.tokenId());
 124 |     | 		assertEq(fee, 500);
 125 |     | 
 126 |     | 		// Same fair-value identity as the Slipstream twin: value only from oracle rates
 127 |     | 		uint256 ratioX96 = (uint256(1e18) * 2 ** 96 / uint256(180e18)) * 1e18 / 1e6;
 128 |     | 		uint256 sqrtPrice = ratioX96 <= type(uint256).max >> 64
 129 |     | 			? Math_sqrt(ratioX96 << 64) << 16
 130 |     | 			: Math_sqrt(ratioX96) << 48;
 131 |     | 		(uint256 expected0, uint256 expected1) = LiquidityAmounts.getAmountsForLiquidity(
 132 |     | 			uint160(sqrtPrice),
 133 |     | 			TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(TICK_LOWER),
 134 |     | 			TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(TICK_UPPER),
 135 |     | 			LIQUIDITY
 136 |     | 		);
 137 |     | 		uint256 positionValue = expected0 + (expected1 * 180e6) / 1e18;
 138 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.calcGav(), 13_600e6 - 1800e6 - 1800e6 + positionValue);
 139 |     | 	}

 141 |     | 	function test_feesCollect_windDown() public {
 142 |     | 		_mintPosition(1800e6, 10e18);
 143 |     | 		uint256 gavBefore = comptroller.calcGav();
 144 |     | 
 145 |     | 		// Fees accrue (100% to the LP on Uniswap — no unstaked-fee skim here).
 146 |     | 		// Fund the mock pool with the fee inventory (in reality swappers paid it in).
 147 |     | 		usdc.mint(address(positionManager), 45e6);
 148 |     | 		nvdax.mint(address(positionManager), 0.25e18);
 149 |     | 		positionManager.addOwedFees(position.tokenId(), 45e6, 0.25e18);
 150 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.calcGav(), gavBefore + 45e6 + 45e6);
 151 |     | 
 152 |     | 		_action(UniswapV3LPPosition.Action.Collect, '');
 153 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.calcGav(), gavBefore + 45e6 + 45e6); // value moved, not created
 154 |     | 
 155 |     | 		// Wind down: decrease all → collect principal → burn → dust removal
 156 |     | 		positionManager.setNextDecreaseAmounts(1800e6, 10e18);
 157 |     | 		_action(UniswapV3LPPosition.Action.DecreaseLiquidity, abi.encode(LIQUIDITY, uint256(0), uint256(0)));
 158 |     | 		_action(UniswapV3LPPosition.Action.Collect, '');
 159 |     | 		_action(UniswapV3LPPosition.Action.Burn, '');
 160 |     | 		assertEq(position.tokenId(), 0);
 161 |     | 
 162 |     | 		vm.prank(manager);
 163 |     | 		comptroller.removeExternalPosition(address(position));
 164 |     | 		assertEq(comptroller.getExternalPositions().length, 0);
 165 |     | 	}
 166 |     | 
 167 |     | 	function Math_sqrt(uint256 x) internal pure returns (uint256) {
 168 |     | 		if (x == 0) return 0;
 169 |     | 		uint256 z = (x + 1) / 2;
 170 |     | 		uint256 y = x;
 171 |     | 		while (z < y) {
 172 |     | 			y = z;
 173 |     | 			z = (x / z + z) / 2;
 174 |     | 		}
 175 |     | 		return y;
 176 |     | 	}
 177 |     | }

 103 |     | 	/// @notice Escrow solvency: the comptroller holds exactly the open request escrow.
 104 |     | 	function echidna_escrow_solvent() external view returns (bool) {
 105 |     | 		return usdc.balanceOf(address(comptroller)) == escrowMirror;

 108 |     | 	/// @notice The high-water mark never decreases — reconfigure, settle, deposit, redeem,
 109 |     | 	///         nothing may reset it (fee-gaming guard).
 110 |     | 	function echidna_hwm_monotonic() external returns (bool) {
 111 |     | 		uint256 hwm = comptroller.highWaterMark();
 112 |     | 		bool ok = hwm >= lastHwm;
 113 |     | 		lastHwm = hwm;
 114 |     | 		return ok;
 115 |     | 	}

 117 |     | 	/// @notice Shares exist iff the fund has value behind them (no free shares, no locked
 118 |     | 	///         value without claims). Vault balance is USDC-only in this harness.
 119 |     | 	function echidna_shares_backed() external view returns (bool) {
 120 |     | 		uint256 supply = comptroller.shares().totalSupply();
 121 |     | 		uint256 vaultBalance = usdc.balanceOf(address(comptroller.vault()));
 122 |     | 		if (supply == 0) return true;
 123 |     | 		return vaultBalance > 0;

 342 |     | 		MockPosition storage position = mockPositions[params.tokenId];
 343 |     | 		amount0 = position.owed0 > params.amount0Max ? params.amount0Max : position.owed0;
 344 |     | 		amount1 = position.owed1 > params.amount1Max ? params.amount1Max : position.owed1;
 345 |     | 		position.owed0 -= uint128(amount0);
 346 |     | 		position.owed1 -= uint128(amount1);
 347 |     | 		MockERC20(position.token0).transfer(params.recipient, amount0);
 348 |     | 		MockERC20(position.token1).transfer(params.recipient, amount1);
 349 |     | 	}
 350 |     | 
 351 |     | 	function burn(uint256 tokenId) external payable {
 352 |     | 		MockPosition memory position = mockPositions[tokenId];
 353 |     | 		require(position.liquidity == 0 && position.owed0 == 0 && position.owed1 == 0, 'not cleared');
 354 |     | 		delete mockPositions[tokenId];
 355 |     | 	}
 356 |     | 
 357 |     | 	function positions(uint256 tokenId)
 358 |     | 		external
 359 |     | 		view
 360 |     | 		returns (
 361 |     | 			uint96,
 362 |     | 			address,
 363 |     | 			address token0,
 364 |     | 			address token1,
 365 |     | 			uint24 fee,
 366 |     | 			int24 tickLower,
 367 |     | 			int24 tickUpper,
 368 |     | 			uint128 liquidity,
 369 |     | 			uint256,
 370 |     | 			uint256,
 371 |     | 			uint128 tokensOwed0,
 372 |     | 			uint128 tokensOwed1
 373 |     | 		)
 374 |     | 	{
 375 |     | 		MockPosition memory position = mockPositions[tokenId];
 376 |     | 		return (
 377 |     | 			0,
 378 |     | 			address(0),
 379 |     | 			position.token0,
 380 |     | 			position.token1,
 381 |     | 			position.fee,
 382 |     | 			position.tickLower,
 383 |     | 			position.tickUpper,
 384 |     | 			position.liquidity,
 385 |     | 			0,
 386 |     | 			0,
 387 |     | 			position.owed0,
 388 |     | 			position.owed1
 389 |     | 		);
 390 |     | 	}
